en: The postcard's front features a black-and-white photographic image of a bridge spanning a wide river, with a steam train crossing and wooded hills in the background. The bottom of the front image has printed text ('Bergebron' and 'Indalselfven'), as well as handwritten Swedish text. The back side shows standard postcard markings, an old Swedish stamp (5 öre), postmark, and handwritten address and message sections in Swedish.
